workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Antigravity native: transient empty output retries fail turns and background tasks stall input injection
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(antigravity-native): submit scrolled prompts above background tasks. Target files: omnigent/harnesses/antigravity_native/bridge.py, tests/harnesses/antigravity_native/test_antigravity_native_bridge.py, tests/harnesses/antigravity_native/test_antigravity_native_reader.py. Also covers the scrolled-draft scenario in #8685 and the background-widget composer case proposed in #13100. (Ref: https://github.com/omnigent-ai/omnigent/pull/12829)

workarounds.symptom: hermes-native: isolated startup can create an invalid state.db and drop the first message
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(hermes): wait for input readiness and avoid duplicate message delivery. Target files: omnigent/harnesses/hermes_native/bridge.py, omnigent/harnesses/hermes_native/forwarder.py, omnigent/inner/hermes_native_executor.py. A fresh Hermes session could lose its first message, reject an empty database created by Omnigent's observer, or receive duplicated text when delivery retried before persistence. Preserve config-version metadata, keep database observation read-only, and wait for both the session-store schema and nonc... (Ref: https://github.com/omnigent-ai/omnigent/pull/13816)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] claude-sdk `run -p` exits 0 and prints the CLI error as the reply when the Databricks apiKeyHelper mints no token
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(claude-sdk): exit non-zero when the apiKeyHelper mints no token. Target files: omnigent/chat.py, omnigent/inner/claude_sdk_executor.py, tests/cli/test_headless_reconcile.py. When a Databricks login expires, the claude-sdk harness gets an empty token from its `apiKeyHelper`. The Claude CLI then reports an error, and `omnigent run -p` printed that error as the answer and exited 0. With this change the run fails with exit 1 and says how to log in again. (Ref: https://github.com/omnigent-ai/omnigent/pull/10845)

workarounds.symptom: claude-sdk: every interrupt discards the live client, so a long session cold-replays after each Stop (bricks before #11978, silently drops history since)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(harnesses): keep Codex, Claude SDK and Pi sessions across Interrupt. Target files: omnigent/inner/claude_sdk_executor.py, omnigent/inner/codex_executor.py, omnigent/inner/executor.py. This fixes the conversation-continuity part of the issue for the Codex, Claude SDK and Pi harnesses. Per-harness Pause/Resume/Cancel capability flags, a cancel reason and actor, and Antigravity are not changed here. A possible follow-up: after a reply with no text, a resumed Claude client resends the earlier user input. That behavior ... (Ref: https://github.com/omnigent-ai/omnigent/pull/12483)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] CLI `omnigent login` cannot complete against GitLab as OIDC IdP: `prompt=login` gives HTTP 500 or loses the return URL, and `OMNIGENT_OIDC_REQUIRE_REAUTH=0` does not stop it being sent
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(auth): let OIDC deployments stop sending prompt=login on forced re-auth. Target files: omnigent/server/oidc.py, omnigent/server/routes/auth.py, deploy/docker/.env.example. Self-managed GitLab can't complete `omnigent login`. On CLI and device-approval logins, Omnigent always sends `prompt=login` and `max_age`. GitLab's re-authentication handler then either returns a 500 (user already signed in) or loses the return URL (user signs in again), so the CLI waits until the ticket expires. `OMNIGENT_OIDC_REQUIRE_REAUTH=0`... (Ref: https://github.com/omnigent-ai/omnigent/pull/13681)
